purpose: Express a firm intention not to act or a negative prediction.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary + まい; group 2 also stem + まい
I will never make the same mistake again.
In this rain, few customers will probably come.
I decided not to gossip about people anymore.
formation: V dictionary + まい; group 2 also stem + まい
restrictions: First-person contexts often mean “will not”; third-person contexts often mean “probably will not”.
mistake: する may become すまい; do not confuse prediction with prohibition.
